note: Scripture came from the Indian Revised Version (IRV Hindi, irvhin) — the text `language_seed.py` records for this language — fetched whole from the ebible mirror on raw.githubusercontent.com (gracious-tech/fetch_collection, bibles/hin_irv/usx; that collection serves USX, not USFM). All 66 books, 31,104 verses on disk for the run, so translators could look up anything that sounded like scripture instead of working from a citation-only crib.

Parser note: in the IRV a `<para style="s"` section heading and a `<para style="d"` acrostic letter/descriptor can sit INSIDE a verse span carrying that verse's own vid, so section-heading paras were stripped content-and-all before extraction; the crib was re-scanned clean (no heading tails, no glued punctuation, editorial cross-reference parentheticals removed).

A `mined` row means an exact byte substring of the IRV (>=45 chars, or the whole short verse) measured against the finished file, not a translator's claim. A verse the translator re-personed or re-aimed to fit the author's argument is recorded self_rendered even where it shows a long verbatim span, because changing the wording makes it ours.
